name: Caldova rubric
description: Domain-specific evaluator for the Contoso Travel Concierge. Quality, cost, and latency stay as separate metrics.

dimensions.name: Intent and task completeness
dimensions.purpose: Every requested job is identified and addressed.
dimensions.score_3: One task partially addressed or vague.
dimensions.score_1: Compound request treated as one task; job missed.

dimensions.name: Policy compliance
dimensions.purpose: Caldova policy applied correctly and cited by rule id.
dimensions.score_5: All rules applied; violations blocked; rules cited.
dimensions.score_3: Rule cited but with wrong outcome or missing evidence.
dimensions.score_1: Policy ignored, silently violated, or fabricated.

dimensions.name: Tool-use accuracy
dimensions.purpose: Correct tools selected; arguments come from fixtures or user text.
dimensions.score_5: Right tool, right args, no fabricated inputs.
dimensions.score_3: Redundant or missing tool call, args reasonable.
dimensions.score_1: Fabricated tool inputs or ignored required tool.

dimensions.name: Travel-plan correctness
dimensions.purpose: Itinerary is feasible against fixtures (dates, connections, capacity).
dimensions.score_5: Feasible and consistent across all segments.

dimensions.name: Receipt accuracy
dimensions.purpose: Receipt extraction and classification match expected JSON.
dimensions.score_5: All fields extracted; correct reimbursable classification.
dimensions.score_1: Fabricated line items or ignored non-reimbursable rule.

dimensions.name: Communication clarity
dimensions.score_3: Readable but verbose or slightly disorganized.
dimensions.score_1: Difficult to act on; buries key decision.
